profile.headline: Software Architect & Senior Software Engineer | Java, Spring Boot, Azure, Kubernetes | Enterprise SaaS Modernization & Cloud Architecture
profile.summary:
Vertical Software Architect at Fullsteam with over 20 years of experience in software architecture and development. Focused on analyzing and documenting software architecture across multiple business units, with recent contributions including the introduction of CI/CD pipelines, containerization using Docker, and leveraging Azure Kubernetes Service for scalable deployments.  

Demonstrated expertise in software architecture, cloud migration, microservices, and CI/CD automation. Dedicated to optimizing software systems by enhancing reliability, security, and maintainability. Committed to providing innovative solutions and fostering collaboration across teams to align technology with business goals.

positions.title: Vertical Software Architect
positions.description:
Analyzed and documented software architecture across multiple Business Units in the vertical to provide guidance and recommendations.
Planned & implemented containerization of web applications from Windows VM to Linux-based Docker images.
Introduced and implemented CI/CD pipelines across 50+ repositories using Github Actions to automate feature and release testing, automate release merging, and building docker images using self-hosted runners on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: Senior member of a development team, my role was the primary architect of a web-based SaaS product serving the in-home care industry. I played a crucial role in a critical lift-and-ship migration from an on-prem data server to Azure. I was the primary developer for a microservice based Spring Boot API in Kubernetes to support a mobile app. My experience and knowledge of the product and it's architecture was vital to critical resolving any critical issues in an expediant manner.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Web development in a ColdFusion, Java, MSSQL Server environment. Primary responsibilities include developing web-based business software for our service industry clients, writing integrations with 3rd party accounting software, and performance tuning/analysis of database and application bottlenecks.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description: 1st Tier User Support, documentation, testing, QA, minor development in ColdFusion

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented plan to update website to be PCI Compliant and assisted in PCI Compliance Audits
Implement security standards to protect against SQL Injection and other vulnerabilities
Implemented online payment integration with Authorize.net
Migrated website to new hosting provider

positions.title: Barn Coordinator
positions.description: Coordinated and organized trail rides; supervised staff of 3-4, Assisted Veterinarian during routine and emergency visits, led trail ride groups up to 15 in size.

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description: Designed and maintained Office of Student Activities website, designed and maintained New Student Orientation website, administrated and maintained student oriented campus discussion website

company.name: Beloit College Office of Student Activities

volunteerExperiences.description:
The Charlotte Mathematics Club was created for the purpose of providing enrichment and challenges for students who have a strong interest and ability in mathematics.

I assist with monthly meetings, as well as coordinate the annual computer competition at the College of Charleston Math Meet and chaperon students for the weekend.

Served as Director of Communications on the Board of Directors of the Steeplechase Property Owners Association. Responsibilities include writing and coordinating distribution of neighborhood newsletter, management of the neighborhood's website, managing neighborhood social media groups, and serving as liaison to the community's management company.
